results.description:
"Did anyone give Mom her 8 PM pills?"
"When did the baby last eat?"
"Who's taking Dad to the cardiologist?"

With HuddleCare, the answer is already on everyone's phone.

HuddleCare is a care coordination app for family caregivers. Use it for elder care when you and your siblings look after an aging parent, as a baby tracker both parents and the grandparents can see, or for the dog. Make a Huddle for each person or pet you care for, invite the people who help, and log it once so everyone knows.

• Medications: one list, every dose logged as given or missed, and a reminder before the refill runs out.
• Care Log: feeds, naps, diapers, pumping and walks. Two taps, and everyone sees it.
• Tasks: every task shows who's on it. Done means done, for everyone.
• Schedule: appointments, PT and pickups on one shared calendar.
• Journal: answer "How's Mom?" once. Everyone who loves her sees it.
• Messages: care talk, just for the people who help.
• Today: what's due across all your Huddles, in one list.
• For the sitter: an Emergency Info Card, and a Week Link that needs no app and expires on its own.

Family can join from an invite link on the web, no download needed. You choose what each person can see and edit. The sitter sees the feeding schedule, not the family's messages.

We don't sell your care content or use it for advertising. Export or delete it any time. In English and Spanish.

HuddleCare records what your team enters. It doesn't give medical advice.

Free to start: one Huddle for up to 5 people, with unlimited tasks, medications and logs, and PDF exports of your records. HuddleCare Plus ($7.99 a month or $79.99 a year) and Premium ($14.99 a month or $149.99 a year) add more Huddles, more people, longer history, unlimited documents, direct messages and photos.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://huddlecare.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://huddlecare.app/privacy/

results.description:
Caring Village is the all-in-one app for family caregivers. Coordinate medications, schedules, tasks, and documents — and keep your whole care circle in the loop — without the chaos of texts, spreadsheets, and missed calls. Whether you're managing an aging parent's care from across the country or coordinating with siblings across town, Caring Village keeps everyone on the same page.

Why Caring Village?

Caregiving is rarely one person's job — but it often ends up that way. Multiple schedules, medications to track, documents to find, decisions to make together. Caring Village brings it all into one secure, family-focused platform so you can spend less time managing logistics and more time being present.

Key Features:

Julia – Your AI Caregiving Assistant
Meet Julia, your AI-powered caregiving assistant. Available anytime, Julia answers questions, offers guidance, and helps families make more informed decisions throughout the caregiving journey.

Advanced Medication Management
Set detailed medication reminders, track adherence, and share updates with your care circle. No more wondering if a dose was taken.

Shared Care Calendar
Keep everyone aligned with a shared calendar that syncs with external calendars so appointments don't slip through the cracks.

Printable Care Calendar
Export and print calendars for offline use or to share with doctors and family members.

Task Lists
Create and assign tasks to care circle members. Family members can volunteer for responsibilities — so caregiving is shared, not shouldered alone.

Expert-Curated Checklists
Access checklists built by caregiving experts to guide you through complex situations, from daily routines to emergency planning.

Customizable Care Plans
Design care plans tailored to your loved one's specific needs, with flexible reminders to stay on track.

Wellness Journal
Track moods, symptoms, and milestones. Share photos and updates with your care circle, where family members can like, comment, and stay emotionally connected — even from a distance.

Secure Document Storage
Store and organize medical records, insurance forms, and legal documents in one secure hub. Everything in one place when you need it most.

Built for Families Who Share the Load

Caregiving doesn't have to fall on one person. Caring Village makes it easy for your whole family to step in — volunteer for tasks, track medications, read updates — so the load is shared and nothing gets missed. Whether your family lives under one roof or across time zones, you'll have the tools to stay aligned, divide responsibilities, and show up for each other.

Who Is Caring Village For?


Family caregivers supporting aging parents
Spouses and partners managing chronic conditions
Families coordinating care across multiple households
Anyone who wants to get organized and share the caregiving load


Over 85,000 families use Caring Village to coordinate care and keep everyone in it.

Download today and see what organized caregiving looks like.

results.description:
Famora is one shared place for your loved one's care. When you're looking after an aging parent or unwell relative alongside siblings, a partner or a paid aide, everyone sees the same picture, without a dozen separate text threads.

TODAY, AT A GLANCE
Log the day as it happens: medication, mood and memory, food and drink, sleep, washing and dressing, and getting out. Add vitals, physical therapy, visitors or spending if you need them. A ring shows what's been covered and what's still due.

MEDICINES, HANDLED
Get a reminder before each dose and mark it taken straight from the notification. Famora keeps count of what's left and tells you when a refill is due.

QUICK CHECK-INS
Note how they're doing in a few taps. A morning check-in and a Sunday summary keep the whole family in the loop.

EVERYTHING ABOUT THEM
Keep the essentials in one place: who they are, their routine, what helps, and emergency info (allergies, medicines and contacts) in large print, ready for a paramedic or a new aide.

CALLS, NOTES AND THE DOCTOR
Log calls with prompts for what to ask. Keep notes and to-dos, and build a list of questions for the next appointment.

CALENDAR AND REPORTS
See the month at a glance and add appointments to your Apple Calendar. Create a care report in one tap, for a week, a month or longer, to bring to an appointment or send to family further away. Track what you spend and who's still owed.

THE WHOLE FAMILY, ON EVERY SCREEN
Invite family with a code. Everyone sees changes as they happen, on iPhone or on any computer at famora.care. Famora keeps working without a signal, and Face ID can lock it.

MY FAMORA: A PAGE OF THEIR OWN
Give the person you care for their own simple page on a tablet or computer, at my.famora.care. They can see their day, tell you how they're doing, ask for a call, tick off their medicines and keep notes of their own. It signs in with a one-time code, with no password to remember.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your family's information is shared only with the people you invite. No ads, and no tracking.

Every plan includes the complete app. Plans differ only in how many family members can join, from a single caregiver up to an unlimited family. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial.

Subscriptions: Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, after any free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

results.description:
Somehow you became the one who keeps track of it all — the pills, the appointments, who said they'd stop by. When a parent is getting older, a partner is in treatment, or someone you love needs care every day, it almost always lands on one person: you.

CircleCare shares the load. Create one care circle around the person you care for, invite the people who help, and everyone works from the same up-to-date picture, whether they live down the street or across the country.

EVERYONE ON THE SAME PAGE
- Medications, appointments, tasks and notes in one shared place
- See who did what: who gave a dose, who finished a task, who left a note
- The activity feed shows every update from everyone in the circle, so nobody has to ask "did anyone check?"
- With reminders on, if a dose isn't marked in time, the alert goes to the person taking it, then to the caregivers, then to the whole circle

MEDICATIONS, SHARED
- Daily, weekly or custom schedules, with reminders
- Mark a dose taken or skipped, and the whole circle sees it
- New: as-needed medications. Log a dose when it's given, like a pain reliever, and everyone can see when the last one was given and by whom

APPOINTMENTS AND TASKS
- One shared calendar for doctor visits, treatments and tests
- Assign tasks and appointments to someone, or leave them open for whoever can help
- Add notes and questions so the next person knows what happened

NEW: THE DAILY UPDATE
Each evening at 7 pm, the Home screen shows a short summary of what the circle logged that day. If something was logged, you get one quiet notification, with no health details in it. It's free, and you can turn it off.

HEALTH INFO WHEN IT MATTERS
Allergies, conditions, doctors, insurance and emergency contacts in one place, ready to share as text or a PDF. Keep documents like test results and insurance cards with the circle too.

FREE TO START, FAIR AS YOUR TEAM GROWS
Free: 1 care circle for you + 1 caregiver. The person you care for can join too and doesn't count toward that. Medications and reminders are free forever. No credit card needed.

Premium, for families with more helping hands:
- Unlimited family members: everyone who helps, in one circle
- Add by voice: say a medication, task or appointment and we fill in the form for you to check. On supported phones.
- Adherence reports to share with doctors, plus calendar import
- 1 GB of documents per circle
- AI care assistant
- Up to 5 care circles

Monthly or yearly, priced fairly for your country. Yearly includes a free trial. Only the person who creates the circle pays. Invited family members never pay.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
This is your family's health information, not ad data. No ads. We never sell your data. Only the people you invite can see your circle.

IN 8 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, French, French (Canada), German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil) and Portuguese (Portugal). Everyone chooses their own.

GET STARTED IN A FEW MINUTES
Create a care circle, add a medication or an appointment, and invite your family. Nobody should have to carry this alone.

Terms of Use: https://circlecare.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://circlecare.app/privacy/

Keeping Mom in the loop shouldn't be a chore.

Diana keeps your aging parent or grandparent connected to family life, without asking them to download an app, create an account, or learn anything new. You just take photos the way you always do. Diana quietly finds the best moments, pairs each one with a warm caption, and asks for your OK. One tap, and the photo and caption arrive as a friendly message on the phone your parent already uses.

YOU LIVE YOUR LIFE. DIANA HANDLES THE REST.
- Take photos with your regular camera app, nothing new to remember
- Diana automatically surfaces the wholesome moments worth sharing, and skips the screenshots, receipts, and everything private or irrelevant
- Each moment comes with a ready-to-send caption, written for you

YOU APPROVE EVERY SINGLE MOMENT
Nothing is ever sent without your say-so. Review each photo and caption, approve it, tweak it, or reject it. Only what you approve reaches your parent. You're always the editor of your family's story.

NOTHING NEW FOR YOUR PARENT TO LEARN
- No app to download on their end
- No account, password, or smartphone required
- Moments arrive as regular texts or WhatsApp messages on the phone they already use

ONE FAMILY LOOP
1. You take photos like you always do
2. Diana finds a great moment and drafts a caption
3. You approve, and Grandpa gets a text that makes his day

BUILT ON DIGNITY AND CONSENT
- Photos are analyzed privately to find shareable moments, never posted anywhere
- Only the moments you explicitly approve are ever sent
- Your parent stays in control too. Diana supports, never takes over

Made for the sandwich generation: anyone juggling kids, work, and a parent who deserves to feel close to it all, without one more thing on the to-do list.

Questions? Visit getdiana.com or reach us at support@getdiana.com.

ianacare is for family caregivers: anyone caring for a parent, spouse, child, or other loved one living with a chronic or serious illness, including dementia.

Caring for someone you love isn't the problem — it's figuring out the unknowns. ianacare helps you get answers, make a plan, and keep track of it all, with real human support behind every step for eligible programs.

Anyone can access iana, Action Plans, the care log, and family coordination, on your phone or computer. If ianacare comes through your employer or the Medicare GUIDE program, you may also have a Care Navigator and additional resources (see below).

CHAT WITH IANA™, YOUR AI CARE COMPANION
Caregiving doesn't have office hours. Ask iana about managing care around a new diagnosis, a difficult behavior, or what to ask the doctor tomorrow, and iana can help you think it through. iana is built on ianacare's I Am Not Alone Care Model, shaped by 50,000+ family journeys, and remembers your situation so you don't have to start over.

KNOW WHAT TO DO NEXT
Answer a few questions about where things stand today, and iana builds your Action Plan: a personalized, prioritized list of next steps with vetted resources and support options. It updates as your situation changes, so it's never a generic checklist.

KEEP TRACK OF THE DAY-TO-DAY
Quick Log captures care notes in a few taps — in the waiting room, the parking lot, or the kitchen at 6 a.m. Care Log History keeps every note and iana chat in one searchable place, and iana can summarize it before an appointment so you walk in prepared.

BRING IN FAMILY & FRIENDS, IF YOU WANT TO
Caring on your own? Everything above works for you. If others want to help, invite them to coordinate meals, rides, and tasks without the group text.

THROUGH YOUR EMPLOYER
If ianacare is a benefit at your work, you also get a Care Navigator, a trained caregiving expert you can message or schedule a call with. You'll also find benefits your employer offers, live events and support groups, and practical articles on the Community Hub. 

THROUGH THE MEDICARE GUIDE PROGRAM
The Medicare GUIDE program supports people living with dementia and the family members who care for them. If ianacare is your GUIDE provider, you may also have a dedicated Care Navigator, dementia-specific support, help arranging rest breaks (respite care), live events and support groups, and the Community Hub. If your Care Navigator is through another GUIDE provider, ianacare adds iana, tailored resources, and live events alongside that support. 

PRIVATE AND SECURE
ianacare follows HIPAA standards to protect your health information, and your data is encrypted to keep it safe. Your information is never sold or used for advertising, and you choose who on your team can see it.

IMPORTANT
iana is an AI, not a substitute for professional medical or mental health advice. Always talk with your care team about medical decisions. In a medical emergency, call 911. If you're in crisis, call or text 988.

Terms of Use: https://ianacare.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://ianacare.com/privacy-policy/
